newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ATLETICO MADRID V BORUSSIA DORTMUND TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ATLETICO MADRID V BORUSSIA DORTMUND TEAMS.

Atletico Madrid - 1-Jose Molina, 3-Toni Munoz, 4-Roberto Solozabal, 6-Santi Denia, 15-Carlos Aguilera, 20-Delfi Geli, 10-Milinko Pantic, 14-Diego Simeone, 24-Radek Bejbl, 9-Juan Eduardo Esnaider, 19-Kiko

Borussia Dortmund - 1-Stefan Klos, 5-Julio Cesar, 14-Paul Lambert, 15-Juergen Kohler, 7-Stefan Reuter, 8- Michael Zorc, 17-Joerg Heinrich, 18-Lars Ricken, 20-Wolfgang Feiersinger, 23-Rene Tretschok, 9-Stephane Chapuisat.
